tensura.skill.icicle_rain.description:
Barrage of ice lances: 60 damage each. 15,000 magicule.
*Hold 6s, release*: fire.
[Repeat] (mastered): keep *holding* to fire more volleys every 5s, 10,000 each.
tensura.skill.icicle_spear.description:
A giant ice spike erupts where you aim, up to 20 blocks away: 200 damage. 40,000 magicule.
*Hold 6s, release*.
tensura.skill.invisible.description:
Invisibility for 120s. Mastered: instead gives Presence Concealment I for 300s, hiding your presence.
*Hold 3s, release*.
tensura.skill.lighten.description:
Speed II and Jump Boost II for 20s (60s mastered).
*Hold 3s, release*: on yourself.
*Sneak+cast*: on the creature you aim at, within 10 blocks.
tensura.skill.liquidize.description:
Turns a 5×5×5 patch of soil or sand into loose dirt, quickmud or quicksand. Also dissolves earth pillars.
*Hold 4s (3s mastered), release* at ground or a pillar within 10 blocks.
tensura.skill.magic_barrier.description:
Blocks magic hits below 1/6 of your HP (1/5 mastered); bigger hits lose half that amount. Uses HP when cast. Lasts 10s (20s mastered). Costs 5% of max magicule, minimum 2,000.
*Hold 8s, release*.
tensura.skill.magic_wall.description:
A 4-block magic wall, 4 blocks ahead, with HP equal to yours. Slows things crossing and weakens magic shots. Lasts 10s (25s mastered).
*Hold 6s (5s mastered), release*.
tensura.skill.mental_crush.description:
Spiritual hit: 10% of max spiritual HP (min 100); resistance halves it. Fragility II for 15s; 25–50% chance of Insanity for 30s. 30,000 magicule.
*Hold 5s, release* within 6 blocks. Mastered: 20% against foes below half spiritual HP.
tensura.skill.mirage.description:
Four illusion clones for 15s (30s mastered).
*Hold 3s, release*: summon.
Mastered: *sneak+hold 6s, release* for eight.
*Sneak+press* at your Mirage clone within 30 blocks: dismiss it.
tensura.skill.mud_hand.description:
Mud hands bind a target within 20 blocks; releasing adds Slowness II for 5s. 5,000 magicule.
*Hold 4s*: bind, then keep *holding* for up to 5s (10s mastered).
*Release*: stop binding.
tensura.skill.mud_spears.description:
Ground spikes; 70,000 magicule.
*Hold 4s, release*.
[Targeted Mode]: foe within 20 blocks; 250 damage plus 50 earth. With Mud Hand active: 2s cast, +50 damage.
[Spread Mode] (mastered): rings around you, 5-block radius; 20 damage, lasts 30s. Stand on ground.
tensura.skill.protection.description:
Protection I adds 20 armor for 120s (600s mastered).
*Hold 5s, release*: on yourself.
*Sneak+cast*: on the creature you aim at, within 10 blocks.
tensura.skill.recovery.description:
Heals up to 50% of max HP. Target players also gain 4 food (8 mastered). Costs 100 magicule per HP healed, minimum 10,000.
*Hold 5s, release*: heal your target within 6 blocks, or yourself if none.
tensura.skill.reincarnation.description:
Resets your race and race data, removes race-granted/temporary skills and clears warp points. Keeps 75% of base max aura and magicule. Requires 10,000 magicule.
*Hold 10s, release*: reset and open reincarnation menu.
tensura.skill.reinforced_barrier.descrip:
HP-scaled damage barriers. Costs 5% of max magicule, minimum 5,000.
*Hold 8s, release*.
[Combined Barrier]: magic and physical defense for 30s.
Mastered: [Magic Defense] or [Physical Defense]: stronger single-type barrier for 15s.
tensura.skill.reinforcement.description:
Reinforcement III reduces gear durability loss for 120s (600s mastered).
*Hold 5s, release*: on yourself.
*Sneak+cast*: on the creature you aim at, within 10 blocks.
tensura.skill.search_enemy.description:
Highlights nearby hostile mobs.
*Hold 2s, release*: lasts 120s; *press* again to end.
[Constant]: *hold* for 2s, then keep holding to maintain it for 5 magicule per second.
tensura.skill.sleep_mist.description:
Sleeping mist around you: 5-block radius, Paralysis II. Cloud lasts 15s (25s mastered). 5,000 magicule.
*Hold 5s, release*.
tensura.skill.spatial_storage.descriptio:
Pocket storage: 54 slots, stacks of 100 (200 mastered).
*Hold 2s, release*.
[Spatial Bag]: creates a bag; mastered: opens storage directly, *sneak+cast* makes a bag.
[Dress Change] (mastered): swaps worn armor with stored armor.
tensura.skill.thunder.description:
Lightning where you aim, up to 30 blocks away: 100 damage in a 3-block radius (200 damage, 5 blocks mastered). 30,000 magicule.
*Hold 1s, release*.
tensura.skill.thunder_lance.description:
Lightning lances; 5,000 magicule.
*Hold 4s, release*.
[Single]: one lance, 50 damage plus 30 lightning.
[Rain] (mastered): a barrage, 30 damage plus 30 lightning each.
tensura.skill.thunder_orb.description:
Fires a thunder orb that strikes nearby enemies every 0.5s: 80 damage plus 40 lightning, 5-block radius (10 mastered). 20,000 magicule.
*Hold 6s (4s mastered), release*.
tensura.skill.thunder_rain.description:
Lightning storm or charged hits; 70,000 magicule.
*Hold 8s (5s mastered), release*.
[Rain]: storm follows you, 17.5-block radius; 300 damage every 4s for 30s.
[Coating] (mastered): next five physical hits add 100 lightning damage.
tensura.skill.tornado_blade.description:
Wind sphere: 150 damage plus 25 wind (300 plus 50 mastered). Mastered: pulls foes and bursts into ten blades, 50 damage each. 40,000 magicule.
*Hold 2.5s, release*.
